newsitem.title: BRAZIL: RESEARCH ALERT - Copel still an ING hold.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Copel still an ING hold.

text.p: -- ING Barings said it was maintaining its hold rating on Parana state power utility Copel common shares and recommending a swap from common stock to preferred shares.
-- "Copel preferred trades at an unsustainable 11 percent discount on the common shares. We recommend a swap from common stock to preferred," it said in a report.

-- It also said it prefers Copel to Cemig at current price levels because "Copel has a more attractive service area with better growth prospects, plans a more aggressive expansion of capacity in coming years, represents a better play on electricity deregulation and is substantially less expensive."
-- Copel common stock was off 1.9 percent at 16 reais, while its preferred shares were up 0.7 percent at 14.40 reais in late morning trade on the Sao Paulo bourse.
